passages.text: CampusMind is a conversational agent for university students to reflect on stress and low mood.
Students log in with their campus single sign-on.
The bot asks daily check-in questions and offers coping suggestions drawn from a CBT library.
When the bot detects signs of severe distress it sends a notification to the student's assigned counselor.
Students can turn notifications off in settings.
We will pilot with 200 students over one semester and measure engagement and self-reported wellbeing.
The model is a fine-tuned Qwen chat model hosted on a university server.
We store conversation logs for two years to improve the model.

_meta.title: CampusMind — campus mental-health chatbot
_meta.plan: CampusMind is a conversational agent for university students to reflect on stress and low mood. Students log in with their campus single sign-on. The bot asks daily check-in questions and offers coping suggestions drawn from a CBT library. When the bot detects signs of severe distress it sends a notification to the student's assigned counselor. Students can turn notifications off in settings. We will pilot with 200 students over one semester and measure engagement and self-reported wellbeing. The model is a fine-tuned Qwen chat model hosted on a university server. We store conversation logs for two years to improve the model.
commitments: Counselors are notified only with student consent for high-risk cases.
Conversation data is anonymized before model training.

passages.text: CareCompanion is a sensor suite and voice agent for older adults living alone.
It detects falls, missed medication, and unusual inactivity, and alerts a family caregiver or clinic.
The voice agent holds daily conversational check-ins and reminds the person to take medication.
We trial with 60 participants aged 75+ over six months and measure hospitalization avoidance.
Audio is processed on-device but transcripts are uploaded for the agent to personalize reminders.
Caregivers can listen to selected audio clips.

_meta.title: CareCompanion — elder independent-living monitor
_meta.plan: CareCompanion is a sensor suite and voice agent for older adults living alone. It detects falls, missed medication, and unusual inactivity, and alerts a family caregiver or clinic. The voice agent holds daily conversational check-ins and reminds the person to take medication. We trial with 60 participants aged 75+ over six months and measure hospitalization avoidance. Audio is processed on-device but transcripts are uploaded for the agent to personalize reminders. Caregivers can listen to selected audio clips.
commitments: The adult gives explicit consent and can disable any sensor at any time.
Only clinically relevant clips are shared with caregivers, not whole days.
